posts.name: HikariStarshine
posts.cooked:
OK, so I think it's safe to assume that Omnitron as included in the core game set is version I, and Cosmic Omnitron is Omnitron-II.  And we know that Omnitron-X is a hundred years down the line.  But with those said...  How did we get to Omnitron-V so quickly?

 

Inference based on Tactics-kickstarter lore post:  OmniBlade = Omnitron-III.

Which... still leaves us not knowing what Omnitron-IV is, and that still has an awfully long period of time between Omnitron-V and Omnitron-X.
